concept.title: Parents and carers
concept.shortdesc: Parents, guardians and carers of children, with some couples and partners.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : Couples, partners, spouses and people looking at relationships, including friends and partners of group members.
: Parents, carers and other family adults (such as grandparents or childminders) who look after children, including parent carers of children with additional needs.
: Parents and guardians as a group, including single parents, fathers and parents who are worried, isolated or seeking company.
